akiec.name: Actinic keratoses / intraepithelial carcinoma
akiec.plain_description: The model class is a label from a dermatoscopic research dataset. It cannot confirm what a spot is.
common_signs: A new or changing spot
A spot that looks different from nearby spots
A spot that itches, bleeds, or does not heal
general_care: Monitor asymmetry, border, colour, diameter, and evolution (ABCDE)
Do not pick or scratch the spot
Use sun protection
Take a dated photo to track changes

bcc.name: Basal cell carcinoma label
bcc.plain_description: This is a model category, not a diagnosis. A clinician must examine a concerning spot.
common_signs: A new or growing spot
Bleeding or a sore that does not heal
A spot that changes or feels irritated
general_care: Monitor asymmetry, border, colour, diameter, and evolution (ABCDE)
Do not pick or scratch the spot
Use sun protection
Take a dated photo to track changes

bkl.name: Benign keratosis-like lesion label
bkl.plain_description: This model category groups some benign-looking lesions in HAM10000; it cannot rule out a serious condition.
common_signs: A raised or flat spot
A spot with a rough or waxy appearance
A spot that may resemble other skin conditions
general_care: Monitor asymmetry, border, colour, diameter, and evolution (ABCDE)
Do not pick or scratch the spot
Use sun protection
Take a dated photo to track changes

df.name: Dermatofibroma label
df.plain_description: This is a research-dataset class. A photo classifier cannot confirm a dermatofibroma.
common_signs: A small skin spot or bump
A spot that may feel firm
A spot whose appearance should be checked if it changes
general_care: Monitor asymmetry, border, colour, diameter, and evolution (ABCDE)
Do not pick or scratch the spot
Use sun protection
Take a dated photo to track changes

mel.name: Melanoma label
mel.plain_description: This model category is not a melanoma diagnosis. New, changing, itching, or bleeding spots should be assessed by a dermatologist.
common_signs: A spot that changes in size, shape, or colour
A spot that looks different from others
A spot that itches or bleeds
general_care: Monitor asymmetry, border, colour, diameter, and evolution (ABCDE)
Do not pick or scratch the spot
Use sun protection
Take a dated photo to track changes

nv.name: Melanocytic nevus label
nv.plain_description: This is a mole-related research-dataset class, not confirmation that a spot is harmless.
common_signs: A pigmented spot
A spot that may look like other moles
Any new or changing spot still needs clinical review
general_care: Monitor asymmetry, border, colour, diameter, and evolution (ABCDE)
Do not pick or scratch the spot
Use sun protection
Take a dated photo to track changes

vasc.name: Vascular lesion label
vasc.plain_description: This model category describes a research-image label and cannot establish the cause of a red or purple spot.
common_signs: A red, purple, or dark spot
A flat or raised mark
A spot that changes, bleeds, or causes concern
general_care: Monitor asymmetry, border, colour, diameter, and evolution (ABCDE)
Do not pick or scratch the spot
Use sun protection
Take a dated photo to track changes
